title: DutchDraCor — KB corpus of 180 early modern Dutch plays (TEI XML)
institution: KB — National Library of the Netherlands (KB LAB)
notes:
Corpus of 180 early modern Dutch plays fully encoded and annotated in TEI XML following DraCor standards, drawing on DBNL and Ceneton transcriptions; available through the DraCor infrastructure with a standalone Zenodo version announced. The stable project URL beyond the KB LAB announcement was not verified in this run; this is a distinct Dutch-language collection, not the catalogued DraCor record itself.

Justification: Identifiable TEI XML text collection of 180 early modern Dutch plays within 1450–1700, freely accessible; found via a web search for new DraCor-family corpora announced on Zenodo and KB LAB.
Found at: https://lab.kb.nl/about-us/blog/presenting-dutchdracor-new-kb-dataset-computational-approaches-early-modern-dutch
